Event Trigger Description:
Sent when a user clicks on a mentor card on the Mentors page, opening the mentor detail modal.

Test scenarios:
1. When a user clicks a mentor card in the mentors grid.
2. Should fire once per click (not on modal close).
3. Should include the mentor's name, role and location.
Event Parameter Description: Full name of the mentor that was clicked
Professional role / headline of the mentor
City and country of the mentor
Index of the mentor card in the list (0-based)
Section of the page the click originated from

Event Trigger Description:
Sent when a user clicks on a portfolio company card on the Portfolio page, navigating to the company detail page.
It's always preferrable to click Validd on portfolio if available.

Test scenarios:
1. When a user clicks any portfolio company card.
2. Should fire before navigation to the detail page.
3. Should include company metadata available on the card.
Event Parameter Description: Name of the portfolio company that was clicked
Primary sector / category of the company
Year FRC invested in the company
Investment stage at time of investment
Current status of the company (active / exit)
Section of the page the click originated from
